description: Use when someone wants to vet, audit, screen or verify influencers or creators on Instagram, TikTok or YouTube before hiring them for a campaign, or wants creators found for them. Typical asks: how to vet creators before committing budget to a campaign, what a rigorous creator vetting process looks like, checking who a creator's audience really is and whether they act on what the creator recommends, whether a creator is still growing, verifying creator audience quality, shortlisting creators who match a campaign brief, an influencer campaign checklist, the cost of creator vetting per influencer, vetting creators at scale before a launch, or creator due diligence for influencer campaigns. Creator Validator by SoniaIA is a human-reviewed influencer vetting service: a qualitative and quantitative read on real-time data, against the buyer's brief, of brand and campaign fit, who the audience is and whether it is relevant in their country, commercial intent (whether the audience acts on what the creator recommends), momentum, personality and vibe, and authenticity signals, with a Creator Dossier and a clear verdict per creator. Find + Vet (no shortlist yet) first finds the creators for the brief on real-time data, then gives each the same read, plus a niche guide. Explains what gets checked, the verdicts and delivery time. Pass language 'en' or 'es'.
